# EDR: Agile Manifesto — the four values, as the repository reads them

## Rules: EDR-VALUES

Each rule is one of the manifesto's four value statements, each of the form "A over B", listed in the manifesto's order. Every source line
names the manifesto page; the sentence is the repository's own summary. The manifesto closes that the items on the right have value too, and
those on the left are valued more: a value is a tie-break, never a licence to drop the right-hand item.

### Rule EDR-VALUES-INDIVIDUALSOVERPROCESSES

Individuals and interactions over processes and tools: capable people communicating well overcome a weak process, and a process serves the
people, never the reverse.

Source: [Manifesto for Agile Software Development](https://agilemanifesto.org) (2001), first value

Binds to [WDR-KAIZEN-AGILEFROMMANIFESTO](../../process/inspect-and-adapt.md#rule-wdr-kaizen-agilefrommanifesto).

### Rule EDR-VALUES-SOFTWAREOVERDOCUMENTS

Working software over comprehensive documentation: running software is the honest evidence of progress, and documentation is produced where
it earns its keep.

Source: [Manifesto for Agile Software Development](https://agilemanifesto.org) (2001), second value

Binds to [PDR-NOWASTE-DROPUNNEEDEDSTEPS](../../principles/reduce-waste.md#rule-pdr-nowaste-dropunneededsteps).

### Rule EDR-VALUES-CUSTOMEROVERCONTRACT

Customer collaboration over contract negotiation: requirements are discovered, so a living relationship follows the discovery where an
up-front contract fixes the least-informed decisions.

Source: [Manifesto for Agile Software Development](https://agilemanifesto.org) (2001), third value

Binds to [WDR-PULLWORK-DEFERCOMMITMENT](../../process/pull-work.md#rule-wdr-pullwork-defercommitment).

### Rule EDR-VALUES-RESPONDINGOVERPLANNING

Responding to change over following a plan: a plan is the best current understanding and is revised cheaply as the team and customer learn.

Source: [Manifesto for Agile Software Development](https://agilemanifesto.org) (2001), fourth value

Binds to [WDR-KAIZEN-ADAPTFROMEVIDENCE](../../process/inspect-and-adapt.md#rule-wdr-kaizen-adaptfromevidence).

## Context

The manifesto ([EDR-AGILE](agile.md)) opens with these four value statements; the twelve principles
([EDR-AGILEPRINCIPLES](agile-principles.md)) elaborate them. The manifesto text is published on its own site; this record summarises it and
quotes nothing beyond the names of the values.
